mentions.name: Cloudventory
mentions.description: This tool provides AWS inventory search with cross-account and cross-region lookup, letting teams quickly find resources like IPs or leftover infrastructure by keyword, and offers security, ops, and cost savings insights. It is in early access/MVP mode.
mentions.problem: Teams without the budget for high-end cloud management platforms need a way to search and inventory their AWS resources.
mentions.audience: Teams that lack the budget for high-end cloud management platforms.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://cloudventory.io – AWS inventory search for teams that don't have the budget for high-end cloud management platforms.

evidence.value: I'm working on https://cloudventory.io – AWS inventory search for teams that don't have the budget for high-end cloud management platforms.
